newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Sinclair Broadcast begun.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Sinclair Broadcast begun.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said on Thursday it started coverage of Sinclair Broadcast Group with a buy rating and a $50 price target.
-- Analyst Tim Wallace said in a research note Sinclair had an aggressive management team which was generating superior operating margins.
-- "The Heritage Media deal and a recently negotiated network compensation plan...should accelate cash flow growth over the next 18 to 24 months," he said.
-- Sinclair said in July it entered into an asset purchase agreement to acquire the radio and television stations of Heritage Media Corp for $630 million in cash.
